dish_name: Escalopes de Dinde a la Creme
instructions: Pat the cutlets dry. If any are thicker than 1/2 inch, pound them between two sheets of plastic wrap. Season both sides with 1/2 tsp of the salt and 1/4 tsp of the pepper.
Zest the lemon and mince the garlic. Chop 2 tbsp of the parsley.

Heat the olive oil and 1 tbsp of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high. When the butter stops foaming, add half the cutlets in one layer. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden. You're cooking them to 160°F in the middle, so if you have a thermometer, check it there. No thermometer? Cut into the thickest one: it's done when there's no pink left. Transfer them to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp butter and cook the rest of the cutlets the same way. Transfer them to the plate.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp of the fat from the pan and turn the heat down to medium. Add the garlic and lemon zest and stir for 30 seconds, until the garlic smells fragrant.
Pour in the cream and add 1/4 tsp of the salt and the remaining 1/4 tsp pepper. Scrape up the browned bits from the pan. Let it boil for 3 to 5 minutes, until it coats the back of a spoon.
Return the turkey and any juices from the plate to the pan and turn it over once in the sauce. Cook for 1 minute, until it's hot. Take the pan off the heat and squeeze in a little lemon juice.
Taste the sauce. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt. Sprinkle with the parsley. Serve with the sauce spooned over the turkey.
method_notes: Dairy Farmers of Canada's Turkey Cutlets with Cream Sauce is the lead (5.0 from only 2 votes, so a fallback lead): cutlets browned in butter, then garlic, lemon peel and cream cooked down in the same pan and finished with parsley. The lead dusts the cutlets with flour; that is dropped here to keep it gluten-free, and the sauce still thickens from reducing the cream. A little olive oil is added so the butter doesn't scorch, and a squeeze of lemon juice goes in at the end (Everyday Healthy Recipes also finishes with lemon). The oven warming step is skipped and the cutlets are cooked in two batches.
